title: Which Animal Sees Colours Humans Cannot?
description:
This animal detects ultraviolet light and patterns of polarisation invisible to us.

Mantis shrimp have specialised photoreceptors that detect ultraviolet and polarised light.

More receptor types do not automatically mean “better colour vision”; their neural processing differs from ours.

Some mantis shrimp can judge distance using a single eye.
